page.meta_description: Burgundy is the terroir textbook: tiny climats, Pinot and Chardonnay, and labels that name a village or a vineyard more loudly than a brand. Related pages:…
page.content:
Pinot Noir and Chardonnay villages of the Côte d'Or and beyond.

How Burgundy connects

  • Topic: Old World wine — Burgundy is the Old World type specimen of village and vineyard terroir.
  • Item: Pinot Noir — Pinot Noir is the red grape of Burgundy's Côte d'Or.
  • Item: Chardonnay — Chardonnay is the white grape of Burgundy and Chablis.
  • Topic: Terroir — Burgundy's climats made terroir the central language of fine wine.

What is Burgundy?

Burgundy is the terroir textbook: tiny climats, Pinot and Chardonnay, and labels that name a village or a vineyard more loudly than a brand.

Key threads lead to Old World wine, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Terroir.
